reviews.text: I bought this serum thanks to the skinfluencer Tina Tanaka Harris. I wasn't really sure what to expect with this serum but... OH-MY-GOD ! The marketing of this serum isn't lying at all, it's really a softening skin serum O-O !!! I always had a rough/textured nose and it's a problem that was really bothering me but with this serum, this problem IS GONE !! My face is sooooo smooth ! I will buy it again and again and again. It's a real game changer in my routine <3
reviews.zh: 我係受 skinfluencer Tina Tanaka Harris 影響先買咗呢款精華。我本來唔太知道會有咩效果，但係……我的天啊！呢款精華嘅宣傳冇講大話，佢真係一款令皮膚變得柔滑嘅精華 O-O !!! 我一直鼻位都粗糙、有紋理，呢個問題真係好煩，但用咗呢款精華之後，呢個問題真係冇咗 !! 我張面超級滑 ! 我會一買再買再買。佢真係改變咗我嘅護膚程序 <3

reviews.text: if you have milia bumps or rough skin this serum is for you I heard it takes 2 weeks to show you result but in 2 days I saw difference in my skin texture use with rice toner I suggest in morning and in evening do retinol next day rest and hydrate with sheet mask then repeat retinol and so on I suggest mild one retinol by cosrx 0.1 it doesn’t irritate your skin then after 5 days do mild exfoliation with toner pads it works best for my skin I achieved my baby skin and I love it ❤️
reviews.zh: 如果你有粟粒疹或者皮膚粗糙，呢款精華啱你。我聽人講要兩個星期先見到效果，但我兩日就見到皮膚質感有分別。我建議配合 rice toner（米化妝水）一齊用。早晚都用 retinol，隔一日休息，用面膜補水，之後再重複 retinol，如此類推。我建議用溫和啲嘅 COSRX 0.1 retinol，佢唔會刺激皮膚。然後每五日用化妝棉做溫和去角質，對我嘅皮膚效果最好。我已經擁有咗嬰兒肌，我好鍾意 ❤️

reviews.text:
Skin Type: Dry, sensitive, acne prone.
This is my holy grail skincare product from the NUMBUZIN brand and I've tried quite a few from the #3 essence, #5 serum, and #5 daily multi vitamin cream. This serum is the only one I have continued to repurchase and stick to. I have already repurchased my 3rd bottle and will continue to do so when I run out. I even got my sister hooked on the serum and it's her favorite out of the brand and her holy grail as well.

Pros: Does not irritate my sensitive skin. Has helped tremendously in my texture and smoothing out my skin. My skin tone seems to be a bit more even but I noticed that this serum is better for any texture you have and smoothing it out vs brightening your skin tone. It took awhile for me to notice some even tone and brightening. 

Cons: Nothing.
reviews.zh:
膚質類型：乾性、敏感、容易爆痘。
呢個係我嘅 NUMBUZIN 品牌必備護膚產品（holy grail），我試過好多款，包括 #3 精華水（essence）、#5 精華，同 #5 日用多種維他命面霜。呢款精華係我唯一一直持續回購、堅持用嘅。我已經回購咗第三支，等用完就會繼續買。我仲令我妹妹都愛上咗呢款精華，佢都話係呢個品牌嘅最愛，亦係佢嘅必備之選。

優點：唔會刺激我嘅敏感皮膚。對改善我嘅膚質同令皮膚順滑幫助好大。我嘅膚色似乎均勻咗少少，不過我留意到呢款精華對任何膚質都好，令皮膚順滑嘅效果好過提亮膚色。我過咗好耐先至見到膚色均勻同提亮嘅效果。

缺點：冇。

reviews.text: i have dry U zone, oily T zone. the i’ve been using this for 2-3 weeks now and i think it helped? when i started using this my texture around my T zone disappeared but i started breaking out on my right cheek, it’s slow going away but i’m still using the serum hoping my skin is just purging and not just now reacting well bc i really wanted to like this serum. i also got 2 pimples around my mouth but that might be a good issue? i brushed my teeth after cleansing before the 2 pimples came in so that might be the case? i’ll update on serum and now it’s worked for me after 1-2 more weeks i reslly want to use this. the consistency is very nice and not sticky at all.
reviews.zh: 我嘅 U 區係乾性、T 區係油性。我用咗呢款大約兩至三個星期，我覺得可能有幫助？我開始用嗰陣，T 區嘅質感好似冇咗，但係右面面頰開始爆痘。雖然慢慢消退緊，我仍然繼續用呢款精華，希望皮膚只係淨化（purging），而唔係真係唔啱，因為我真係好想鍾意呢款精華。我嘴巴周圍都出咗兩粒痘，但可能係好嘅跡象？我洗完面之後先刷牙，然後兩粒痘先出現，可能就係咁嘅原因？我會再更新精華嘅情況；如果再過一兩個星期就見到效果，我真係好想繼續用。質地好好，唔會黏黏地。

reviews.text: this has to be my absolute FAVORITE skincare product in general as of now. been using it for a month and I’ve been loving it more and more. I started noticing results a few days after using it :D the fermented ingredients seem to really be doing wonders. it has helped a ton with texture on my skin, specifically tint bumps etc and it has overall made my skin look and feel so much smoother. In addition, it plumps my skin so much and I’ve noticed my skin is so so much more firm, bouncy and healthy looking. so hydrating as well. if I could only use one serum for the rest of my life this would probably be it. absolutely love love love it. love the texture too it’s a typical serum viscosity but it’s so lightweight and fast absorbing. I’ve seen people recommend it more towards dry skin types but I have a combo to oily skin that’s acne prone and I haven’t encountered any problems so I’d say it’s perfect for all skin types
reviews.zh: 到目前為止，呢款一定係我最愛嘅護膚品！用咗一個月，我越用越鍾意。用咗幾日之後開始見到效果 :D 發酵成分好似真係有好神奇嘅效果。對我皮膚嘅質感幫助好大，尤其係小粒凸點（tiny bumps）等等，整體令皮膚睇落同摸落都順滑好多。另外，佢令我皮膚好飽滿，我發覺皮膚更緊緻、有彈性、睇落更健康。補水效果都好好。如果我一生只可以用一款精華，大概就係呢款。我真係好愛好愛好愛。質地都好鍾意，係一般精華嘅黏稠度，但好輕盈、吸收好快。我見過人話佢較適合乾性膚質，但我係混合至油性、易長痘嘅皮膚，冇遇到任何問題，所以我會話佢啱所有膚質。

reviews.text: As I get more into skincare, I’m trying to get more into esoteric k-beauty, and following less-known k-beauty YouTubers: two of which (Soo Beauty and Tina Tanaka Harris) got me onto numbuzin, and specifically the No. 3 Skin Softening Serum. This “bodlebodle repair” serum (if you know what that means, please tell me because I think it’s fun to say) has a beautiful formula. It’s super watery, with 42% bifida ferment lysate and 21% of my ingredient bestie galactomyces ferment filtrate, along with fun things like silk and goat milk extract, and a bunch of other skin barrier goodies.
reviews.zh: 我越嚟越深入研究護膚，開始深入接觸比較小眾嘅 K-beauty，並跟隨一啲較少人知嘅韓國 YouTuber。其中兩位（Soo Beauty 同 Tina Tanaka Harris）令我認識咗 numbuzin，尤其係 3 號 Skin Softening Serum。呢款「bodlebodle repair」精華（如果你知咩意思，請話俾我知，因為我覺得講嚟好好玩）配方好靚。佢超級水潤，含 42% 雙歧桿菌發酵裂解物，同埋 21% 嘅 galactomyces 發酵濾液（我嘅成分好拍檔），仲有絲蛋白同羊奶提取物等好玩嘅成分，以及一大堆其他屏障修護好嘢。

reviews.text: I'm still testing this as I'm currently breaking out and I'm not sure which product in my routine is the culprit. That being said, this serum seems decent - it feels slightly more moisturizing than hydrating but leaves a nice glowy finish. I do live in a dry winter climate at the moment though, so I have to use a good occlusive on top of this in order to reap the benefits. I feel like this would be more effective in humid climates and I will probably use this more in the summer when the humidity level rises.
reviews.zh: 我仍然喺測試緊，因為我而家正在爆痘，我唔確定日常護理入面邊個產品係元兇。話咁講，呢款精華感覺幾好——比較偏滋潤多過補水，但會留下好靚嘅光澤。不過我而家住喺一個冬天乾燥嘅地方，所以要喺上面搽一隻好嘅封閉型保濕產品，先可以達到效果。我覺得呢款喺潮濕嘅氣候會更有效，我可能夏天濕度上升嗰陣會多啲用。

reviews.text: It is one of the bestsellers from this brand and for a good reason. This serum is mainly fermented ingredients based, so it's main aim is brightening and skin's elasticity, which works well for me, though I just started using it, so it's early days, I might update more at a later stage. It's lightweight, pleasant to use, absorbs well. Those sensitive to fermented ingredients and with fungal acne, should steer away as I think it might not be suitable for them. So far I'm loving it.
reviews.zh: 呢款係呢個品牌嘅暢銷產品之一，係有原因嘅。呢款精華主要以發酵成分為基礎，所以主要目的係提亮同改善皮膚彈性，對我嚟講幾有效，不過我啱啱開始用，所以仲未算好長時間，之後可能會再更新。質地輕盈、用起嚟舒服、吸收好。對發酵成分敏感嘅人，以及有真菌性痘痘嘅人，應該避開，因為我諗佢可能唔適合呢類人。到目前為止，我好鍾意。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
